meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接、脚本或简介生成产品发布与宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有产品链接或营销文案,想快速做出发布宣传视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link, script, or brief into a launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a product link or brief and need a launch video fast.

howto.what: 把产品网址、粘贴的脚本或简要说明变成发布/宣传/演示视频:抓取品牌素材、选设计预设、写分镜与脚本、逐帧搭建,最终输出 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你想推广、发布或揭晓某个产品时触发;任意商业网址默认走这里,网站导览/展示需求也留在此流程。

say.text: 用 acme.com 做一个产品发布视频
say.note: 会先抓取该网站,作为素材与解说来源

say.text: 根据这份脚本做一条功能揭晓的宣传片
say.note: 脚本按原文存为 user_script.txt,再进入分镜

say.text: 把我们的官网做成一段导览展示视频
say.note: 网站导览/展示类也由这个流程接管

howto.what_en: Turns a product URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo/demo video: captures brand assets, picks a design preset, writes storyboard and script, builds frames, outputs renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; any commercial URL defaults here, and site tours or showcases stay in this workflow.

say_en.text: Make a product launch video for acme.com
say_en.note: It captures the site as the asset source.

say_en.text: Turn this script into a feature-reveal promo
say_en.note: The script is saved as user_script.txt first.

say_en.text: Make a site tour video of our homepage
say_en.note: Site tours are handled by this workflow too.
